scopeNote: integration contract: Pure-Swift client conforming to FirebaseAuth public API via Pyric WebSocket bridge transport. Covers Auth instance/lifecycle, email/password and anonymous authentication, user creation, sign-out, session restoration, reactive auth and ID token listeners and AsyncSequence streams, User identity properties, ID token retrieval and profile mutation, multi-tenancy and impersonation via AuthLens, and PyricFirestore credential provider coupling.
